description: When you least expect it, things can go wrong: missed flights, lost bags, sudden illness, or even a stolen passport. With ICEA LION Travel Insurance, you are covered so you can focus on enjoying your trip and making memories, not worrying about what-ifs. Whether you are flying out of Kenya or coming in for a few days or longer, we have your back. Some countries even require travel insurance to issue a visa, and with us, you can get your travel insurance certificate online in minutes.

key_benefits: Medical Evacuation & Hospital Cover – If you fall sick or get injured, we’ll cover your transport and medical costs, including home follow-up care.
Daily Hospital Cash – Admitted abroad? We’ll compensate you for each full day in the hospital.
Emergency Dental Care – Acute tooth pain while abroad? We have got that covered too.
Emergency Medical Expenses – ICEA LION covers you for emergency medical expenses incurred as a result of injury or illness while travelling outside Kenya and travelling to Kenya from other countries.
Trip Cancellation or Curtailment – Plans changed because of illness, accidents, or other disruptions? We’ll refund your covered costs.
Missed Departure Support – Missed your flight due to unavoidable delays? We’ll help with extra travel and hotel expenses if the delay exceeds more than 6 hours.
Delayed or Lost Luggage – Get reimbursed for essential items if your bags are delayed for more than 6 hours or lost.
Lost Passport – We’ll help cover the cost of replacing it.
Emergency Return Home – If you need to head back due to the death of a close family member, we’ll cover your return.
Repatriation & Burial Costs – We’ll handle the costs to return you home or for a funeral where you are.
Personal Accident Cover – Get compensated in case of disability or death caused by an accident during your trip.

Consular & Legal Referrals – We’ll help connect you to the right people.

description: ICEA LION Value Added Term Assurance helps you protect your loved ones while saving for a set period. If the unexpected happens, your beneficiaries receive the full Sum Assured. If you complete your term alive, you get back all your premium contributions. We also offer Level Term Assurance, which provides a higher payout but does not refund premiums if you outlive the term.
premium_notes: Contact ICEA Lion for a personalised quote.
key_benefits: Immediate Protection: From the moment your policy is active, your beneficiaries are covered. In case of your passing, they receive the full Sum Assured immediately. Note that if your first year’s premium is not fully paid, a proportional deduction will be made from the final payout.
Affordable & Flexible: Struggling to pay? Reduce premiums to as low as KES 2,000 and adjust later. Choose monthly, quarterly, or annual payments that suit your lifestyle.
Contribution Break (Re-Dating): Pause your policy if needed and restart later without extra fees. You can do this once per policy term.

Tax-Free Benefits: Your Sum Assured is paid tax-free when your policy matures. If employed, notify your HR to enjoy 15% monthly tax relief. Self-employed? Claim it via the Kenya Revenue Authority (KRA).
Protect Your Loved Ones’ Future: Ensure your family maintains the lifestyle you envision. For extra protection, consider estate planning or setting up a trust, like our ICEA LION Milele Trust.

Book A Call ICEA LION Whole of Life Plan The ICEA LION Whole of Life Plan is designed to give you and your loved ones financial security for life. It pays a lump sum (one-time payment) to your beneficiaries when you pass away and also provides coverage in case of disability or a serious illness. Think of it as a lasting asset like property or stocks that you can leave to your family, helping them stay financially secure without selling important assets. How It Works: How It Works: Key Benefits Pick your Sum Assured and pay regular premiums over 10, 15, or 20 years. Coverage lasts for life, ensuring your chosen amount is paid to your loved ones when needed. Tax Relief: Get 15% of your premium back (up to KES 60,000/year). Flexible Premiums: Pay monthly, quarterly, semi-annually, or annually. No Medical Check: For coverage up to KES 5 million, skip the medical exam. Critical Illness Cover: A lump sum is paid on diagnosis of serious conditions like cancer, stroke, heart attack, organ transplant, paralysis, Alzheimer’s, and more. Permanent Disability Cover: Receive a lump sum if you experience permanent total or partial disability, from accident or illness.
